id: title:eli-r-ph:keep the write pool off a demoted aurora reader

review.posthog_relevance: Adds database connection pooling resilience and demoted reader detection to PostHog's property-definition service, replacing generic health checks with a writer guard that prevents recycling demoted readers as writers.
review.reason: Adds a shared database dependency, exports a writer guard module, and integrates it into the property-definition service's connection pool. P1.F6.H2 and P1.F5.H1 show the replacement of generic pool creation with a guarded, jittered pool. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 establish the guard and clarify the operational boundary. P1.F1.H1 adds the dependency. This is a substantive, bounded, and
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the shared library implementation and configuration not shown; no test results or runtime behavior are demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a correctness improvement, not on observed production benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Cargo dependency, common-database, to the Rust workspace.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides database-related shared libraries used by PostHog's Rust components; its inclusion establishes a dependency path for database-related functionality.

observations.behavior: Exports a new module, writer_guard, and its associated types and functions, including install_writer_guard, WriterGuard, and related configuration and counter names.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the writer guard implementation available for use in database connection pooling, enabling PostHog to detect and handle demoted Postgres readers after a failover.

observations.behavior: Updates a comment to clarify that the existing connection health check does not cover a demoted writer, and that writer_guard is needed to prevent the pool from recycling a reader as a writer.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. P1.F4.H1 is a Rust test-only chunk; P1.F5..P1.F8.H1 are production Rust changes. No missing context or unrelated PRs. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Rust dependency, common-database, to property-defs-rs Cargo.toml.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the property-definition service use the shared database writer guard and its configuration, rather than relying on the generic database crate.

observations.behavior: Replaces the generic PgPool creation with a new build_write_pool function that installs the writer guard and adds jittered connection lifetime.
observations.posthog_connection: The property-definition service now uses the writer guard to detect and recover from demoted Aurora readers, while also adding jitter to connection lifetimes to avoid lockstep reconnection across pods.

observations.behavior: Adds the WriterGuard and its config to the property-definition service's app context, including a named pool and a jittered lifetime calculation.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes the property-definition service's database connection with the writer guard, which replaces the generic ping-based liveness check with a write-capable guard that can detect demoted readers.
